why: MDX and HOME_REDIRECT are read by pmndrs/docs, not by zustand: the step says 'Separately, clone the pmndrs/docs ... Inside the pmndrs/docs directory: create a .env file' (lines 80-82). pmndrs/docs reads both (dev.sh, start.sh and preview.sh export MDX; its .github/workflows/build.yml sets HOME_REDIRECT from the home_redirect input that zustand's .github/workflows/docs.yml passes). Nothing in zustand reads them (git grep: CONTRIBUTING.md only).
